title: 第一卷 第13章 俯首认错，人心冷暖
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
院门缓缓推开。

    赵山站在门口，手中提着一个布囊，神色忐忑不安。

    他昨日得知苏玄尘是极品天灵根天才之后，一夜未眠。

    满心惶恐、悔恨、后怕。

    他万万没想到，自己连日嘲讽、主动寻衅的百岁老朽。

    竟是整个青玄宗、整个青州都极其罕见的绝世仙苗。

    若是苏玄尘记仇，只需一句话。

    他在外门的修行之路，直接断绝，甚至会被严惩逐出门墙。

    一夜思虑，他终于下定决心，上门负荆请罪。

    赵山低头躬身，姿态放得极低。

    “师弟前日眼拙，不识天骄，多次冒犯师兄，言语无状，多有得罪。”

    “今日特地前来，向苏师兄赔罪，还望师兄海涵。”

    说完，他双手递过手中布囊。

    “这里是师弟积攒的三十块下品灵石、三枚下品疗伤丹，一点薄礼，聊表歉意，还请师兄收下。”

    态度恭敬，诚意十足。

    跟前几日嚣张跋扈、仗势欺人的模样，判若两人。

    苏玄尘静静看着他，神色平淡无波。

    百年岁月，他看惯了人情冷暖、世态炎凉。

    世人敬的从来不是人，是实力、是天赋、是未来。

    前日他看似弱小可欺，人人都能上来踩一脚。

    今日他天赋曝光，万众瞩目，昔日仇敌主动低头认错、送礼赔罪。

    修仙界，和凡俗红尘，终究是一个道理。

    趋利避害，拜高踩低。

    苏玄尘淡淡开口：

    “修行之人，戒骄戒躁。你年少气盛，争强好胜，不算大错。”

    “知错能改，便是道心精进。”
content_en:
The courtyard door slowly opened.

    Zhao Shan stood at the door, holding a cloth bag in his hand and looking uneasy.

    He stayed up all night after learning that Su Xuanchen was a top-grade Tianlinggen genius yesterday.

    Full of fear, regret, and fear.

    He never expected that he would be a hundred-year-old man who he had been mocking and actively provoking for days.

    It was actually a peerless immortal seedling that was extremely rare in the entire Qingxuan Sect and the entire Qingzhou.

    If Su Xuanchen holds a grudge, it only takes one sentence.

    His path of cultivation in the outer sect will be cut off directly, and he may even be severely punished and expelled from the outer gate.

    After thinking about it all night, he finally made up his mind and came to plead guilty.

    Zhao Shan bowed his head in an extremely low posture.

    "Junior brother was blind the other day and didn't recognize the genius. He offended senior brother many times. His words were incomprehensible and offended many times."

    "I came here specifically today to apologize to Senior Brother Su and to wish Senior Brother Haihan."

    After saying that, he handed over the cloth bag in his hands.

    "Here are thirty low-grade spiritual stones, three low-grade healing pills, and a few small gifts that junior brother has accumulated. I would like to express my apology and ask senior brother to accept them."

    The attitude is respectful and sincere.

    He was completely different from the arrogant, domineering and bullying person he had been in the past few days.

    Su Xuanchen looked at him quietly, with a calm expression.

    Over the course of hundreds of years, he has become accustomed to seeing the warmth and warmth of people and the harshness of the world.

    What the world respects is never people, but strength, talent, and the future.

    The day before yesterday, he seemed weak and easy to bully, and anyone could step on him.

    Today, his talent was exposed and attracted everyone's attention. His former enemies took the initiative to bow their heads and admit their mistakes, and sent gifts to apologize.

    The world of cultivating immortals and the mortal world are ultimately the same.

    Seek advantages and avoid disadvantages, worship the superior and despise the inferior.

    Su Xuanchen said calmly:

    "Practitioners, beware of arrogance and impetuosity. You are young and energetic, and you are competitive and competitive. It is not a big mistake."

    "Recognizing mistakes and being able to correct them means that the Taoist mind is diligent."
title_en: Volume 1, Chapter 13: Admit your mistake, people's hearts are warm and cold
